Container.Name: beechview
Container.Overview: BeechView: a touch-friendly video player for Pinchflat downloads, designed for Apple HomeView's square screen in Safari. Each folder in the shows folder becomes a show. Copy the BeechView files into the App folder before starting.
Container.Requires: Copy the BeechView files (server.js and the public folder) into the App folder first.

Config.Name: App folder
Config.Description: Folder containing BeechView's server.js and public folder.

Config.Name: Shows folder
Config.Description: Folder whose sub-folders are the shows (Pinchflat's output folder).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port to open in Safari, e.g. http://192.168.10.80:8080

Config.Name: Rescan interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How long a folder scan is reused before checking for new shows again.
